summary_alerts.html:
CONSENSUS BUY — META (McCaul (R) + Khanna (D), cross-party)
2 members, combined disclosed value ~$24K. Cross-party alignment on a mega-cap communication name is a modest but notable data point, since it is not driven by partisan sector preferences. The disclosed dollar amounts are small, so the signal is directional rather than size-weighted.

CONSENSUS SELL — INTU (McCaul (R) + Gottheimer (D), cross-party)
2 members, combined disclosed value ~$16K. Two members from opposing parties trimming the same software name in the same window is worth flagging, though the small size limits how much weight the signal should carry. It may reflect shared rebalancing rather than a shared view on fundamentals.

CONVICTION — David McCormick GS ~$1.23M, 7 purchases
A single member concentrating roughly $1.23M across seven separate purchases of one financial name represents an unusually high conviction pattern relative to the rest of the tracked group. Repeated accumulation of the same ticker over the window is more informative than a single opportunistic trade.
